resolved_observability_findings.resolution: All three LangSmith retriever spans use deterministic process_inputs/process_outputs allowlists, compact ForecastContext/version and stage identity, and handled-exception policy. Query text, full context/state, chunks, citations, URLs, titles, headers, backend payloads and error strings are excluded from processed traces.

Monotonic measured Vector, Graph, RRF/fusion and overall Hybrid latency plus result/evidence/citation/degradation counts are emitted in compact telemetry. Graph extraction/upsert records measured latency, document/entity/relation/skipped/failure counts and deterministic lifecycle state. Retrieval resume is not applicable; Graph write recovery is caller retry over deterministic MERGE identities; partial writes raise sanitized GraphUpsertError after recording failed/degraded lifecycle.

Backend exception text and private source URLs no longer enter failure results, logs or Sentry values. Stable VECTOR_RETRIEVAL_FAILED, GRAPH_TRAVERSAL_FAILED, GRAPH_EXTRACTION_FAILED and GRAPH_UPSERT_FAILED codes replace untrusted strings; Sentry receives stable capture_message values only.

implementation_contract.graph: Immutable Stage-03 document/chunk/evidence identities and deterministic relation observation identities preserve every temporal version; unknown required time remains quarantined.
implementation_contract.retrieval: One ForecastContext constrains Vector and Graph before ranking/traversal; temporal Graph never falls back to unbounded legacy on error.
implementation_contract.fusion: Vector, Graph and RRF preserve shared citations and expose hybrid, vector_only, graph_only or unavailable degradation.
implementation_contract.privacy: Trace processors and lifecycle telemetry are count/code/version only; sentinel tests reject query, evidence, URL, secret and exception leakage.
implementation_contract.legacy: Legacy callers without ForecastContext remain supported; no legacy route, namespace or data was removed.
